note: Realistic 'mediocre but not egregious' contract — exercises the amber band and the amber/red boundary, which is the hardest calibration case for the model. No insurance clause is present at all (missing-clause case, distinct from the vendor-unfavorable contract's data-sensitivity context).

expectedFindings.why: Cap exists but vaguely worded ('reasonable amount'), no defined ceiling.
Mutual, but broadly worded 'any and all claims' with no scoping to specific triggers.
Work product ownership stated but no background IP carve-out or license-back language.
Net 45 with clear cadence but no late-payment interest term.
Mutual termination for convenience, but only 10 days' notice (below the 30-day green threshold).
Cure period is only 10 days, shorter than the 15-day amber/green boundary in the rule guidance.
1-year survival, and silent on trade secrets.
Ontario courts — unfamiliar but not obviously unfavorable jurisdiction for either party.
Process referenced (email documentation) but no formal approval chain or fee-impact process.
Review window defined, but standard is subjective ('to Client's satisfaction') rather than objective.
